units.source_text: 月亮从不动山的山际升起。

en.t: The moon rose from the ridge of Mount Fudo.

units.source_text: 金阁从背面承受着月光，折叠着黑暗而复杂的影子，寂然无声，惟有究竟顶的花格子窗框，泻入了清亮的月影。

en.t: The Golden Pavilion received the moonlight from behind, folding dark and intricate shadows into itself, silent and still; only through the latticed window frame of the Kukyocho flowed the clear moonlit glow.

units.source_text: 究竟顶四周通风，朦胧的月亮仿佛就呆在那里。

en.t: The Kukyocho was open to the wind on every side, and the hazy moon seemed to linger there.
